subject.title: [Feature]: Offline Command Queue for iOS/Android Node App

question: Should OpenClaw accept a durable mobile command outbox for private text and voice intents, and what staged storage, replay, retention, and review-before-send contract should it use?
rationale: The feature would persist sensitive user-authored commands before Gateway delivery and replay them later, so automation cannot choose the privacy, dedupe, background-sync, and product-scope boundary for maintainers.

options.title: Stage text outbox with explicit privacy contract
options.body: Start with a narrow text-only mobile outbox, require idempotent Gateway acks, captured-time metadata, bounded OS-protected storage, delete controls, and real device proof before expanding to voice and queue management.

options.title: Design full cross-platform command outbox first
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers approve one iOS/Android contract covering text, voice/audio, edit/reorder UI, retention, Wi-Fi/background behavior, and diagnostics.

options.title: Defer beyond read-only mobile cache work
options.body: Keep only offline transcript cache work in flight for now and revisit command replay after the security and mobile UX roadmap is clearer.

recommendation.title: Stage text outbox with explicit privacy contract
recommendation.body: Start with a narrow text-only mobile outbox, require idempotent Gateway acks, captured-time metadata, bounded OS-protected storage, delete controls, and real device proof before expanding to voice and queue management.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the active Android outbox and related mobile cache path and has the strongest current routing signal for this product/security choice.
